name: plasma-demo
description: Modern Zig WebAssembly Plasma Software Renderer Demo

scripts.build: echo '🚀 Compiling Zig to WebAssembly (ReleaseFast)...' && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
scripts.build:debug: echo '🚀 Compiling Zig to WebAssembly (Debug)...' && zig build
scripts.dev: bun run build && echo '🌐 Starting local dev server...' && bun x serve web -l 9000
